covers: Tuesday 17 November 2026 from 17:20 to 21:15 SAST: the JSE close and Wall Street trade to 20:41 SAST, with Monday's closes for reference
headline: Wall Street down about 1.1% ahead of Nvidia's results after trimming earlier losses; JSE closed 0.8% lower
summary: The JSE All Share closed 0.8% lower at 110,616 and the Top 40 0.8% lower at 102,752, with the rand at R16.93/$, about 1.0% weaker than Friday (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 17 Nov 2026 20:41 SAST). By 20:41 SAST the S&P 500 was at 7,332 (-1.1%) and the Nasdaq at 24,245 (-1.1%) against Monday's close, slightly above the levels seen at 18:57 SAST, as investors waited for Nvidia's results later today (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 17 Nov 2026 20:41 SAST). Platinum was 3.0% lower on the day at $1,430, a drag on JSE miners, while Brent was 1.9% higher at $93.44; SA CPI on Wednesday and the SARB decision on Thursday remain the main local tests.

items.title: S&P 500 and Nasdaq both about -1.1% at 7,332 and 24,245
items.summary: At 20:41 SAST (13:41 New York) the S&P 500 was at 7,332.06 against Monday's close of 7,416.59 (-1.1%) and the Nasdaq Composite at 24,245.44 against 24,509.76 (-1.1%), up from 7,311 and 24,129 at 18:57 SAST. Both remain about 3-4% below Friday 13 November (S&P 7,561.67; Nasdaq 25,136.27).
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 17 Nov 2026 20:41 SAST; Monday close 16 Nov 2026

items.title: US 10-year yield eases to 5.10%
items.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield was 5.097% at 20:41 SAST, down from 5.141% at 17:39 SAST, Monday's close of 5.121% and Friday's 5.154%. The October FOMC minutes are due on Wednesday.

items.title: JSE All Share closes 0.8% lower at 110,616
items.summary: The All Share closed at 110,616.44 against Monday's close of 111,525.58 (-0.8%) and the Top 40 at 102,752.15 against 103,628.96 (-0.8%). The index finished above the midday low of 110,164 reported in the Midday update, but is about 1.6% down on Friday's close of 112,388.

items.title: Telkom interim: revenue +2.0% to R22.5bn, HEPS +9.3% to 334.1c, no interim dividend
items.summary: For the six months to 30 September 2026 Telkom's group revenue rose 2.0% to R22,537m and EBITDA 5.8% to R6,375m (margin 28.3%); HEPS rose 9.3% to 334.1c and free cash flow 37.8% to R998m. No interim dividend was declared, in line with its annual payout policy. Mobile service revenue grew 4% to R11.5bn and fibre homes connected rose 15.1% to 870,856, while BCX revenue fell 8.2%. On MTN, the results repeat Monday's cautionary: talks are at an early stage and there is no certainty a deal will happen. Telkom is not on the LRC coverage list.
items.source: Telkom SENS via InsidEntity, 17 Nov 2026 09:01; TechCentral, 17 Nov 2026 07:39

items.title: CPI on Wednesday, SARB on Thursday
items.summary: October CPI is due on Wednesday 18 November (September: 4.5%) and the SARB announces its decision on Thursday 19 November with the repo rate at 7.25%. A Reuters poll quoted on Monday expected October CPI at 5.1%.
items.source: Reuters via CNBC Africa, 16 Nov 2026 08:56 GMT; LRC Market Dashboard, 13 Nov 2026

items.title: Nvidia reports tonight under interim CEO Colette Kress
items.summary: Nvidia reports quarterly results on Tuesday 17 November, its first since Jensen Huang's resignation as CEO last week. Analysts expect revenue up 91% to $108.93bn (TipRanks, 16 Nov 2026). The shares were at $158.70 in early trade on Monday, below our $262.56 fair value. Our BUY rating is unchanged; the results, not the leadership news, are the real test of it.
items.source: City AM, 16 Nov 2026 14:38 GMT; TipRanks, 16 Nov 2026

items.title: AMD fell with the chip group on Monday
items.summary: AMD was down 5.1% at Monday's open after an 8.8% fall on Friday. Our SELL rating is unchanged.
